// Projection roles occupy the high bits so resolved tokens carry their build path.
export const enum InlineRole {
  Raw,
  Text = 1 << 6,
  Leaf = 2 << 6,
  Pair = 3 << 6,
  Decorate = 4 << 6,
}

export const enum InlineKind {
  None,

  // Raw candidates become source gaps unless resolution gives them semantic meaning.
  AsteriskRun,
  UnderscoreRun,
  TildeRun,
  ImageOpen,
  BracketOpen,
  BracketClose,

  LiteralText = InlineRole.Text,
  Escape,
  Entity,
  Newline,
  // An unmatched resource tail still decodes escapes and entities.
  LinkTail,

  HardBreak = InlineRole.Leaf,
  CodeSpan,
  HtmlComment,
  InlineHtml,
  Autolink,
  FootnoteReference,
  MathText,
  Binding,
  Emoji,
  InlineComponent,

  // Pair kinds alternate even opens and odd closes; resolution keeps them properly nested.
  EmphasisOpen = InlineRole.Pair,
  EmphasisClose,
  StrongOpen,
  StrongClose,
  DeleteOpen,
  DeleteClose,
  LinkOpen,
  LinkClose,
  ImageLinkOpen,
  ImageLinkClose,
  ReferenceOpen,
  ReferenceClose,
  ImageReferenceOpen,
  ImageReferenceClose,
  InlineSpanOpen,
  InlineSpanClose,
  InlineComponentOpen,
  InlineComponentClose,

  Attributes = InlineRole.Decorate,
}

(value, info, firstLine, firstColumn, firstOffset, lastLine, lastColumn, lastOffset) {
	let lang = info || null;
	let meta = null;
	if (info && codeInfoComplex.test(info)) {
		const rawInfo = semanticText(info);
		const langEnd = rawInfo.search(/[ \x5ct]/);
		lang = rawInfo ? langEnd < 0 ? rawInfo : rawInfo.slice(0, langEnd) : null;
		const metaStart = langEnd < 0 ? -1 : rawInfo.slice(langEnd).search(/[^ \x5ct]/);
		meta = metaStart < 0 ? null : rawInfo.slice(langEnd + metaStart);
	}
	return {
		type: "code",
		lang,
		meta,
		value,
		position: {
			start: {
				line: firstLine,
				column: firstColumn,
				offset: firstOffset
			},
			end: {
				line: lastLine,
				column: lastColumn,
				offset: lastOffset
			}
		}
	};
}

	const info = source.slice(infoStart, lineEnd);
	if (nodeBuilder && lines.physicallyContiguous()) {
		const firstLine = start + 1;
		const last = end - 1;

		text: content,
		value: info
	});
